'''Ull Haber''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] from [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], Haber fled to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. There he became a [[Propaganda/Legends|propagandist]] for the Separatists, using his knowledge of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] and genetics to deliver agitprop over the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]] to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] citizens. Haber claimed that the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] had suppressed the genes that would allow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to integrate with mainstream society, and that the Republic had covered up numerous incidents in which clones were maddened by bloodlust and had massacred Republic civilians. Haber also claimed that the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] had promised the clones settlement on selected Republic "liberty worlds" after the war, which would be ruled as the clones saw fit.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
